_comment: Realty REST egg for Pterodactyl. Exported/imported via Admin > Nests > Import Egg.
name: Realty REST
author: 42793301+md5sha256@users.noreply.github.com
description: Standalone, read-only HTTP API over a Realty MariaDB database. Configured entirely by environment variables -- no config file is templated by the egg.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Builds realty-rest's shadow jar from source and stages it as
# realty-rest-all.jar, matching this egg's startup command.
#
# REALTY_REST_GIT_URL and REALTY_REST_GIT_REF may be overridden as build
# arguments if the panel forks this repository.
set -e

GIT_URL="${REALTY_REST_GIT_URL:-https://github.com/MCCitiesNetwork/realty.git}"
GIT_REF="${REALTY_REST_GIT_REF:-main}"

apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git

cd /mnt/server
rm -rf build-src
git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_REF}" "${GIT_URL}" build-src
cd build-src
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew --no-daemon :realty-rest:shadowJar

cp build/libs/*-all.jar /mnt/server/realty-rest-all.jar 2>/dev/null || cp realty-rest/build/libs/*-all.jar /mnt/server/realty-rest-all.jar
cd /mnt/server
rm -rf build-src

echo "Install complete: /mnt/server/realty-rest-all.jar"

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: MariaDB JDBC URL, without the jdbc: prefix (the app prepends it). Example: mariadb://db-host:3306/realty

variables.name: Database Username
variables.description: MariaDB user the service authenticates as. Read-only access is sufficient; realty-rest never writes.

variables.name: Bind Host
variables.description: Address the HTTP server binds to inside the container. Leave as 0.0.0.0 unless you know you need otherwise.

variables.name: Bind Port
variables.description: Port the HTTP server listens on. Must match the port allocated to this server in the panel.

variables.name: Max Page Size
variables.description: Upper bound accepted for the pageSize query parameter on paginated endpoints.

variables.name: Query Module URL
variables.description: Base URL of the query-service module used to enrich responses (e.g. world dimension, player display name). Leave blank to disable enrichment -- those fields are returned as null.

variables.name: Query Module Secret
variables.description: Shared secret sent to the query-service module on every call. Only used when Query Module URL is set.

variables.name: Query Module Timeout (ms)
variables.description: Per-call timeout before a module-sourced field degrades to null.
